units.source_text: 这诗写在一张灰色纸上。

en.t: This poem was written on a sheet of gray paper.

units.source_text: 时在暗夜，墨色也不辨浓淡，无法写得美观。

en.t: It was deep night, and even the light and dark shades of the ink could not be distinguished, so it could not be written beautifully.

units.source_text: 只是信笔挥洒，加上包封，立刻交付使者拿回去了。

en.t: He simply let the brush move freely, added a wrapping and seal, and immediately handed it to the messenger to take back.
